description: I do not and will not accept any form of mistreatment #nervoussystem #LifeByDesign #SoftLife
transcript: You have one chance to mistreat me. People know exactly what they're doing. They know what they say to you, they know how they treat you, they know how they approach situations with you, and I don't accept you doing the same thing to me multiple times. Once you show me what it is, I believe you. You don't have to convince me of anything. I see who you are.
